evidence: RichTextParser::compile -> parse_html accepts \r\n with ordinary budgets. Entity no-amp path preserves CR/LF; bold/default metadata produce contiguous (0,1)/(1,2) runs. ascii_runs_are_canonical accepts them and returns both unchanged although cached unicode-segmentation-1.13.3 GB3 treats CRLF as one cluster. Builder::finish and CompiledRichText construction preserve the split. Exact code trace/hashes and independent readonly QA are in the root proof; no executed test claimed.
impact: Published rich text can split one extended grapheme across differing StyledRun metadata; run_for_range(0,2) returns None for the complete CRLF cluster, while separate byte ranges resolve different styles. No particular visual regression is claimed.
impact_or_question: Published rich text can split one extended grapheme across differing StyledRun metadata; run_for_range(0,2) returns None for the complete CRLF cluster, while separate byte ranges resolve different styles. No particular visual regression is claimed.
next_action: The product owner should account for CRLF in ASCII admission or use the common grapheme alignment policy, add a targeted differing-style HTML/BBCode CRLF regression, and run it through managed validation. This audit only records the defect and preserves behavior.
source_label: // BUG: [CR-TEXT-RICH-ASCII-GRAPHEME-0001] 不同样式把 "\r\n" 分为 (0, 1)/(1, 2) 时，此快路径拆开同一字素；HTML "\r\n" 可达，GB3 要求 CRLF 不断开。
